name: Guinea Pig
blurb: Fragile guts and a daily vitamin C need — check before you feed.
intro: Guinea pigs can't make their own vitamin C and have sensitive digestion, so the right vegetables and fruits matter. Every verdict below cites a veterinary or rescue source.

name: Rabbit
blurb: Hay-and-greens herbivores prone to gut stasis — sugar and the wrong foods are the danger.
intro: A rabbit's diet should be mostly hay, with a large daily handful of leafy greens and only small amounts of veg and fruit as treats. Unlike guinea pigs, rabbits make their own vitamin C and tolerate brassicas — but they're very prone to gut stasis, so sugar and starch are risky. Every verdict below cites a veterinary or rescue source.
